entries.title: Kingston Windfall cocktail recipe
entries.summary:
The *Kingston Windfall* is a fall-inspired craft cocktail that combines
Jamaican rum with autumnal apple cider and spice notes.

Ingredients

   - *1½ oz (45 ml)* Jamaican rum
   - *¾ oz (22 ml)* Freshly squeezed lemon juice
   - *¾ oz (22 ml)* Apple cider syrup (or cinnamon apple cider syrup)
   - *¼ oz (7.5 ml)* Honey syrup (3:1 ratio of honey to water)
   - *1 dash* Angostura bitters

Instructions

   1.
      - *Combine* all ingredients into a cocktail shaker filled with ice.
   - *Shake* vigorously until well-chilled.
   - *Strain* the mixture into a chilled coupe glass.
   - *Garnish* with a dash of bitters on top and a light dusting of
      cinnamon.

entries.title: Daq in Black (Amaro Nonino Edition)
entries.summary:
Daq in Black (Amaro Nonino Edition)

Ingredients.

   - 1 oz dark Jamaican rum (such as Blackwell, Appleton Estate 8 Year, or
   Coruba)
   - 0.5 oz Cognac (VS or VSOP)
   - 0.5 oz Amaro Nonino
   - 0.5 oz demerara syrup (1:1 or rich 2:1, depending on how sweet you
   prefer)
   - 0.5 oz fresh lime juice
   - 1 dash Fee Brothers Black Walnut Bitters
   - Glassware. Chilled coupe or Nick & Nora glass.
   - Garnish. Expressed lemon peel.

Preparation Steps

   - Chill the glassware. Fill your coupe with ice water or place it in the
   freezer before you start measuring.
   - Combine ingredients. Add the Jamaican rum, Cognac, Amaro Nonino,
   demerara syrup, lime juice, and black walnut bitters into a cocktail shaker.
   - Shake vigorously. Fill the shaker two-thirds full with solid ice cubes
   and shake hard for 10 to 12 seconds until the outside of the tin is frosty.
   - Double-strain. Dump the ice from your coupe and strain the cocktail
   through a fine-mesh strainer to catch any small ice shards.
   - Garnish and serve. Express a fresh strip of lemon peel over the
   surface of the drink to release the oils, rub the rim lightly, and drop it
   in.

drinkIngredients: 1 oz dark Jamaican rum (such as Blackwell, Appleton Estate 8 Year, or Coruba)
0.5 oz demerara syrup (1:1 or rich 2:1, depending on how sweet you prefer)
1 dash Fee Brothers Black Walnut Bitters
steps: Chill the glassware. Fill your coupe with ice water or place it in the freezer before you start measuring.
Combine ingredients. Add the Jamaican rum, Cognac, Amaro Nonino, demerara syrup, lime juice, and black walnut bitters into a cocktail shaker.
Shake vigorously. Fill the shaker two-thirds full with solid ice cubes and shake hard for 10 to 12 seconds until the outside of the tin is frosty.
Double-strain. Dump the ice from your coupe and strain the cocktail through a fine-mesh strainer to catch any small ice shards.
Garnish and serve. Express a fresh strip of lemon peel over the surface of the drink to release the oils, rub the rim lightly, and drop it in.
